content.text: Build and test pass — the `@DataJpaTest` boots an embedded H2 datasource, Hibernate creates the `person` table, and the repository save/find round-trip succeeds.

The earlier verbose run already confirmed success (table created, insert executed, no errors). Project structure:

```
pom.xml
src/main/java/com/example/demo/
  DemoApplication.java
  Person.java
  PersonRepository.java
src/main/resources/application.properties
src/test/java/com/example/demo/PersonRepositoryTests.java
```

- `pom.xml`: `spring-boot-starter-parent` 3.3.4, Java 17, `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa` + `spring-boot-starter-web`, H2 runtime driver for local dev, `spring-boot-starter-test`.
- `Person`/`PersonRepository`: minimal JPA entity + `JpaRepository` to show the persistence pattern.
- `application.properties`: in-memory H2 datasource with `ddl-auto=update` and console enabled — swap the datasource props for Postgres/MySQL when you have a real DB.
- Verified with `mvn test`: schema auto-created and a save/find round-trip passed.

To swap in a real database, add its JDBC driver dependency and change the four `spring.datasource.*` properties.
